about_the_game:
"In the lonely wasteland that leads to a mining site, someone dumps the body of a woman and a series of horrible clues with the cryptic message of her killer at night. Who is hiding to commit such atrocities and why? Nicolas, the young owner of Bar Delirio, has decided to discover the murderer to protect the life of the only family he has left: his little niece. But he won't be alone. If he trust the right person, he might find more than just the truth. Maybe he will end up discovering his true desires in the Delirium."

Romance and thriller Visual Novel in English and Spanish.

  • Crafting recipes for Bar Delirio.

  • Explore Aguasvivas Town with map events.

  • Collect mysteries and solve the case.

  • 5 unique characters to choose a romance.

  • Multiple Endings based in your choices.

Night in Delirium is being developed with Ren'Py. Currently it has a demo available with a tutorial and two chapters of the story.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A series of murders puts a town in Chile on alert, and the police are unable to identify the perpetrator and his strange messages. Meanwhile, Nicolas, the young owner of Bar Delirio, suspects that the culprit is hiding among his frequent customers.
